propositions: A ticket directory with no CREATE or SNAPSHOT event causes the plan-relation reducer to fail with reducer-error, surfacing as INDETERMINATE verdict on unrelated tickets whose relation graphs include the orphan directory.
The failure is not transient; it persists until the empty directory is manually removed, and git cannot track or prevent the artifact because git does not track empty directories.
The plan-relation reducer walks the store filesystem listing and fails completely on encountering an event-less directory, rather than skipping it with a warning and continuing with other tickets.
The plan-review gate fails closed (llm_ran: false) on this error, stalling reviews for entire epics despite the broken directory being unreferenced by any ticket.

The fix adds reader-side tolerance in the reducer to skip event-less directories with a warning, rather than changing the writer to avoid creating the directory early, because writer-side cleanup cannot cover process-death orphans and would race concurrent writes.
